sonnet.problem: "servants" is a wrong answer here, but it was the right answer on card 6 of this same stop. An answer already shown on an earlier card is reused.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: Verse 2 begins "if the message spoken by angels was binding…". The question says the writer states as fact that the message "was binding", and drops the "if".
Card 1 already quotes the line and asks which angel God ever said it to. Card 2 then asks the same fact, so the answer is effectively given just before the question.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact.

sonnet.problem: The True statement (pay closer attention so that we do not drift away) just repeats what story card 1 said ("We must pay closer attention to what we have heard"), plus the verse's closing phrase.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it.
